8.10. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.railyard¶

The module defines functions for manipulating railyard.

Functions

copyData(railyard[, refMap]) Return a copy of the data structures in the railyard, keeping relative references intact.
elimCrossings(railyard, crossingNodes, …) Eliminate crossing nodes in crossingNodes in the railyard.
filterCopy(railyard, relations, …) Filter a copy of the data structures in the railyard.
restrict(railyard, areaRestriction[, …]) Return a copy of the data structures in the railyard restricted to areaRestriction, keeping relative references intact.
